source.title: Bryon - Evergreen Sentinel
source.name: Bryon
source.description: A magical Marksman who is gifted with extraordinary perception and has a falcon to fight with.

skills.name: Falcon Raid

description.raw: Passive. When a battle starts, Bryon gains 1000 Energy and summons his falcon Elona. Active. Bryon consumes 300 - 80 (SP-based) Energy, calling Elona to deal 320% (ATK-based) damage to his current target. Elona remains on the battlefield, consuming increasing amounts of Energy over time. When she runs out of Energy or Bryon is defeated, Elona leaves the battlefield. Elona cannot be attacked and will ignore the terrain and prioritizes Bryon's target. Elona's normal attack deals 90% (ATK-based) damage.

text: Elona gains enhanced effects after 8s into a battle.
Normal attack damage is increased by 20%, and Haste is increased by 40.
The enhancements are reset when Elona leaves the battlefield.
Elona gains enhanced thunderbolt effects after 18s into a battle, reducing Haste of adjacent enemies by 30 and dealing 40% (ATK-based) damage per second.
The enhancements are reset when Elona leaves the battlefield.
Elona's normal attack damage is increased to 100% (ATK-based).
Elona's normal attack damage is increased to 110% (ATK-based).

skills.description_lite: Bryon summons Elona to deal damage to the current target and fight alongside.

skills.name: Leafblade Gale

description.raw: Bryon summons 4 magic leaves to attack the target. Each leaf deals 90% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage.

skills.name: Shadow Flash

description.raw: Passive. Bryon's normal attacks and skills deal damage 2 times, absorbing targets' 50 Energy. Active. Bryon deals 190% (ATK-based) damage 2 times.

text: Bryon's normal attacks and skills deal damage 2 times, granting Elona's next normal attack with thunderbolts, dealing additional damage equal to 4% + 0,5% (SP-based) of enemy's current HP, along with a skill interruption effect.
The extra damage cannot exceed 240% + 15% (SP-based) of Bryon's ATK, up to 3 stacks.
Active.

skills.name: Hero Focus

skills.description_lite: Bryon's Haste increases during battle, and it further increases when Elona is on the battlefield.

skills.name: Tacit Strike

description.raw: Elona deals 350% (ATK-based) damage to the enemy and stuns them for 3s when Bryon is being controlled or receives damage exceeding 15% of his max HP from a single hit. This skill takes effect once every 20s and can only be triggered when Elona is on the field.
active: Elona deals 350% (ATK-based) damage to the enemy and stuns them for 3s when Bryon is being controlled or receives damage exceeding 15% of his max HP from a single hit.
This skill takes effect once every 20s and can only be triggered when Elona is on the field.

text: When Bryon takes a fatal blow for the first time, Elona consumes all the Energy to block the fatal damage and restores 200% (ATK-based) HP for Bryon.
For the next 5s, Bryon cannot be targeted and recovers 40% (ATK-based) HP per second.
Then Elona departs from the battlefield and cannot be summoned for 10s.
Elona's counterattack damage is increased to 400% (ATK-based).
Elona's counterattack damage is increased to 450% (ATK-based).

skills.description_lite: When Bryon is being controlled or taking a single high-damage attack, Elona deals hhigh damage to the enemy and stuns them. Elona can block the fatal damage for Bryon.
